Otherwise, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that unit equal to the results on the dice used for the 2D6 roll multiplied together. For example, a 2D6 roll of 2 and 6 would inflict 12 mortal damage (2 × 6).

abilities.name: Chooser of the Mighty

The replacement unit can only be set up in combat with units that the **mighty** unit was in combat with when it was picked to be **mighty**. Then, 1 model in the **mighty** unit is slain.

rules.name: Arrogant Big 'Uns

rules.name: Strike! Hur Hur!

rules.declare: Pick up to 2 friendly **MEGA-GARGANT** units within 3" of any terrain features and pick any friendly **GARGANT** units within 3" of any terrain features to be the targets.
rules.effect: Double the Attacks characteristic of each target’s ranged weapons for the rest of the turn. If the target has no ranged weapons, pick an enemy unit within 12" of the target instead and roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that enemy unit equal to the roll.

rules.name: Ten-League Strides

rules.effect: Each time a friendly **BIG** or **LITTLE** unit uses the 'Redeploy' command or the 'Run' ability, if you roll a 1-2 when determining the distance that unit can move, you can use a value of 3 instead.

armiesOfRenown.name: King Brodd's Stomp
armiesOfRenown.lore:
Most famed and feared of all Mega-Gargants is the mighty King Brodd, priest of Behemat and scourge of the small folk. Fuelled by hatred of those who slew his forefather and desperate for revenge, Brodd gathers to his side gargants from across the Mortal Realms, uniting them in a stomp of epic proportions.

When you pick the Sons of Behemat faction for your army, you can choose for it to be a King Brodd’s Stomp Army of Renown. If you do so, use these faction rules instead of the Sons of Behemat faction rules. Every unit in your army must be drawn from the units listed in the roster options, as described in Army of Renown: King Brodd's Stomp. All units in your army gain the Brodd’s Stomp keyword.

rules.name: The World Titan's Prophet
rules.phaseDetails: Passive
rules.effect:
While any other friendly **BRODD’S STOMP** units are within a friendly **King Brodd**’s combat range:

• That friendly **King Brodd** has **WARD (5+)**.
• Each time you make a successful ward roll for that friendly **King Brodd**, allocate 1 damage point to another friendly **BRODD’S STOMP** unit within its combat range after the damage sequence for that friendly **King Brodd** has been resolved (ward rolls cannot be made for those damage points).

rules.name: Wrath of Brodd
rules.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle (Army), Your Charge Phase
rules.declare: Pick a friendly **BIG** unit that has not used a **DESTRUCTIVE IMPULSE** ability this turn to use this ability.
rules.effect: If the unit using this ability charged this turn, roll a dice. On a 3+, that unit can move 3D6" but must end that move in combat. When it does so, it can pass through terrain features and enemy models as if it had **FLY**.’

rules.name: Watch This!
rules.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
rules.declare: Pick a friendly **BIG** unit that has not used a **DESTRUCTIVE IMPULSE** ability this turn to use this ability, then pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target.
rules.effect:
If the target is a **HERO**, **BEAST**, **MONSTER** or **WAR MACHINE**, roll 6 dice. Otherwise, roll a dice for each model in the target unit. For each roll that is equal to or greater than the target’s Save characteristic, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

The **BIG** unit using this **DESTRUCTIVE IMPULSE** ability has **STRIKE‑LAST** for the rest of the turn.

rules.name: Double Stomp
rules.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
rules.declare: Pick a friendly **BIG** unit that has not used a **DESTRUCTVE IMPULSE** ability this turn to use this ability.
rules.effect: Roll a D6. On a 3+, for the rest of the turn, add the result to the Attacks characteristic of the **Almighty Stomp** of the unit using this ability.

rules.name: Timberrrrr!
rules.phaseDetails: Passive
rules.effect: Each time a friendly **BIG** unit or **LITTLE** unit model is slain, before removing it from play, the players must roll off. The winner picks a point on the battlefield within 3" of that model. Inflict D3 mortal damage on each unit (friendly and enemy) within 3" of that point that has a lower Health characteristic than that model.

rules.name: Smash It All To Bits
rules.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Shooting Phase
rules.declare: Pick a friendly **BIG** unit that has not used a **DESTRUCTIVE IMPULSE** ability this turn to use this ability, then pick a terrain feature within its combat range. Then, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of that **BIG** unit to be the target.
rules.effect: Roll a D3 for each friendly and enemy unit on the terrain feature that was picked. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that unit equal to the roll. After rolling for all those units, roll a dice. On a 3+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

rules.name: Crafty Creepers
rules.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
rules.declare: Pick a friendly **BIG** unit that has not used a **DESTRUCTIVE IMPULSE** ability this turn to use this ability. Then, pick an enemy **HERO** that has an artefact of power and is in combat with that **BIG** unit to be the target.
rules.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, the target no longer has that artefact of power.

artefacts.name: Lucky Shiny Hat
artefacts.effect: This unit has **WARD (4+)** against damage points inflicted by **SPELL** and **PRAYER** abilities and by abilities used by **MANIFESTATIONS**.

heroicTraits.name: I Can Do That Better
heroicTraits.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle (Army), Reaction: You declared the ‘Wrath of Brodd’ ability for a friendly unit
heroicTraits.effect: This unit can use the ‘Wrath of Brodd’ ability immediately after the ‘Wrath of Brodd’ ability used by the other friendly unit has been resolved. This unit can do so even if it has used another **DESTRUCTIVE IMPULSE** ability this turn.

spells.name: High Expectations
spells.declare: Pick a friendly **BRODD’S STOMP PRIEST** to chant this prayer, then make a chanting roll of D6.
spells.effect: Until the start of your next turn, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons used by friendly **BRODD’S STOMP** units while they are wholly within 12" of the chanter. If the chanting roll was 9+, add 2 to the Attacks characteristic instead.

armiesOfRenown.name: Matriarch's Mob
armiesOfRenown.lore:
Should she take a liking to a gargant, her eerie mutterings can see the brute swell to a gigantic size in moments; this, it is said, is why Maegran has not achieved the stature of a Mega-Gargant herself, for she uses her own spiritual bigness to fuel this magic. But if a gargant should offend Maegran, a terrible fate waits them. Tracing glyphs in the muck and walling a curse, Maegran will arrest her victim's growth or, if bitterly displeased, shrink them to the size of a boulder, an ogor or, even worse, a human.

When you pick the Sons of Behemat faction for your army, you can choose for it to be a Matriarch's Mob Army of Renown. If you do so, use the faction rules on these pages instead of the Sons of Behemat faction rules. Every unit in your army must be drawn from the units listed in Army of Renown: Matriacrh's Mob. All units in your army gain the **MATRIARCH'S MOB** keyword.

rules.name: I've Heard She Can...
rules.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
rules.effect:
Pick 1 of the following effects:

***... Shoot Fire From Her Eyes!:*** Inflict D3 mortal damage on each visible enemy unit within 12" of the friendly **Ma Maegran.**

... ***Turn You Into a Human!:*** Pick a visible friendly unit wholly within 12" of the friendly **Ma Maegran.** Until the start of your next turn, enemy units have a maximum control score of 1 while they are in combat with that unit.

***... Make Ya Big and Strong!:*** Pick another visible friendly unit wholly within 12" of the friendly **Ma Maegran.** Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of that unit's weapons for the rest of the turn.

. . . ***Whiz the Biggest Bangers!:*** Add 1 to casting rolls for the friendly **Ma Maegran** until the start of your next turn.

rules.name: Oi! Gerroff!
rules.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle (Army), Any Combat Phase
rules.declare: If the friendly **Ma Maegran** is in combat and damaged, pick up to 3 friendly **Mancrusher Gargants** on the battlefield that are visible to her to be the targets.
rules.effect: Each target has **STRIKE-FIRST** for the rest of the turn.

rules.name: Summon the Herd
rules.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle (Army), End of Any Turn
rules.declare: If the friendly **Ma Maegran** is on the battlefield, pick each enemy **non-FLY non-MONSTER** unit that is visible to her to be the targets.
rules.effect: Roll a number of dice for each target equal to the current battle round number. For each 4+, allocate **1** mortal damage to the target (ward rolls cannot be made for those damage points).

rules.name: Don't Let Nuffin' Happen To Her!
rules.phaseDetails: Passive
rules.effect:
While the friendly **Ma Maegran** is within the combat range of another friendly **LITTLE** unit:
• She has **WARD (5+).**
• Each time you make a successful ward roll for her, allocate 1 mortal damage to another friendly **LITTLE** unit within her combat range after the damage sequence for her has been resolved (ward rolls cannot be made for those damage points).
• Ignore negative modifiers to hit rolls and wound rolls for that other friendly **LITTLE** unit's combat attacks.

other.name: Butt of the Lash
other.phaseDetails: Any Combat Phase
other.effect: If this unit is wholly within 12" of a friendly **Ma Maegran,** remove this unit from the battlefield and set it up again within her combat range. This unit can only be set up in combat with enemy units that are in combat with the friendly **Ma Maegran.**

other.name: Ghyranite Whirlstone
other.phaseDetails: End of Any Turn
other.declare: Pick a visible friendly **MATRIARCH'S MOB** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
other.effect: **Heal (D3)** the target.

spells.name: A Shepherd's Watchful Eye
spells.declare: Pick the friendly **Ma Maegran** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
spells.effect: Until the start of your next turn, friendly **MATRIARCH'S MOB** units have **WARD (6+)** while they are wholly within 12" of and visible to the caster.

spells.name: Mystical Demands
spells.declare: Pick the friendly **Ma Maegran** to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly **MATRIARCH'S MOB** unit wholly within 18" of her to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
spells.effect: If the target is in combat, it can use the 'Retreat' ability as if it were your movement phase. If the target is not in combat, it can use the 'Normal Move' ability as if it were your movement phase. In both cases, the target must end that move no further from the caster than it was at the start of the move.

spells.name: Sic 'Em!
spells.declare: Pick the friendly **Ma Maegran** to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly **MATRIARCH'S MOB** unit wholly within 12" of her to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
spells.effect: Add 1 to the Damage characteristic of the target's melee weapons, including **Companion** weapons, for the rest of the turn.

unitPool: Ma Maegran, Chooser Of The Mighty

armiesOfRenown.name: Stomper Tribe
armiesOfRenown.lore:
There is little difference between a gargant tribe and a gargant army, but Stomper Tribes stand out for how they embrace their violent nature. It should not be any surprise that Warstompers lead them, given how fervently these gargants maintain that a day spent without a trampling is a day wasted.

When you pick the Sons of Behemat faction for your army, you can choose for it to be a Stomper Tribe Army of Renown. If you do so, use the faction rules on these pages instead of the Sons ofBehemat faction rules. Every unit in your army must be drawn from the units listed in Army of Renown: Stomper Tribe. All units in your army gain the **STOMPER TRIBE** keyword.

rules.name: Stomp! Stomp! Stomp! Stomp!
rules.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
rules.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with a friendly **STOMPER TRIBE** unit to be the target.
rules.effect:
Roll a dice. Add 1 to the roll for each friendly **STOMPER TRIBE** model in combat with the target.
On a 5+:
• The target has **STRIKE-LAST** for the rest of the turn.
• Inflict 3 mortal damage on the target.

rules.name: Get In There, You Runts!
rules.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
rules.declare: Pick a friendly **LITTLE** unit that is within a friendly **BIG** unit's combat range, visible to it and not in combat to be the target.
rules.effect: You can re-roll charge rolls for the target for the rest of the turn, and the target has **FLY** for the rest of the phase.

rules.name: Grab Those Rocks and Chuck 'Em!
rules.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle (Army), Any Shooting Phase
rules.declare: Pick each friendly **LITTLE** unit wholly within 18" of and visible to a friendly **BIG** unit and not in combat to be the targets.
rules.effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of each target's ranged weapons for the rest of the turn.

rules.name: Gettin' Stuck In
rules.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
rules.declare: Pick a friendly **STOMPER TRIBE** unit in combat to be the target.
rules.effect:
If the target is **LITTLE,** pick a model in the target unit. Add 1 to the Damage characteristic of that model's melee weapons for the rest of the turn.

If the target is **BIG,** add 1 to the Rend characteristic of its melee weapons for the rest of the turn.

rules.name: Stompin' About
rules.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
rules.declare: Pick a friendly LITTLE unit wholly within 12" of and visible to a friendly **BIG** unit to use this ability.
rules.effect: That **LITTLE** unit can move D6+3". It can pass through the combat ranges of enemy units but cannot end that move in combat. Then, you can inflict D3 mortal damage on each enemy unit that has a lower Health characteristic than that **LITTLE** unit and that it passed across during that move.

artefacts.name: Sparky Shield
artefacts.effect: While they are wholly within 12" of and visible to this unit, friendly **STOMPER TRIBE** units have **WARD (6+)** against damage inflicted by shooting attacks.

heroicTraits.name: Absolutely Fuming
heroicTraits.effect: Add 2 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit's **Almighty Stomp** if it did not use a **FIGHT** ability in the previous turn.

heroicTraits.name: Eager for the Fight
heroicTraits.effect: When making charge rolls for this unit, add 1 to the number of dice rolled, to a maximum of 3, then remove 1 dice of your choice and use the remaining dice as the charge roll.

other.name: Future Stomper
other.phaseDetails: Passive
other.effect: This unit can use the 'Power Through' command even if it has not charged this turn.

other.name: Carefully Watched
other.phaseDetails: Reaction: You declared a FIGHT ability for this unit
other.effect: Pick a friendly **BIG** unit that has not used a **FIGHT** ability this turn and is wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target. The target can be picked to use a **FIGHT** ability immediately after the **FIGHT** ability used by this unit has been resolved. Add 1 to hit rolls for attacks made by this unit and the target for the rest of the turn.

other.name: Little Hopper
other.phaseDetails: Passive
other.effect: This unit can be picked to use the 'Stompin' About' ability even if it is not wholly within 12" of and visible to a friendly **BIG** unit.

other.name: Keen Bean
other.phaseDetails: Passive
other.effect: While this unit is wholly within 12" of and visible to a friendly **BIG** unit, it can use **CHARGE** abilities even if it used a **RUN** ability in the same turn.

spells.name: Pipsqueak Curse
spells.declare: Pick a friendly **SONS OF BEHEMAT WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
spells.effect: Subtract 1 from wound rolls for the target's attacks until the start of your next turn.

spells.name: Thornfang's Wrath
spells.declare: Pick a friendly **SONS OF BEHEMAT WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly **SONS OF BEHEMAT MONSTER** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
spells.effect: The target's melee weapons have **Crit (Mortal)** for the rest of the turn.

spells.name: Energy Surge
spells.declare: Pick a friendly **SONS OF BEHEMAT WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly **SONS OF BEHEMAT MONSTER** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
spells.effect: If the target is **BIG**, add 1 to rampage rolls for it until the start of your next turn. If the target is **LITTLE**, until the start of your next turn, it can use **CHARGE** abilities even if it used a **RUN** ability in the same turn.

spells.name: Rock Bottom
spells.declare: Pick a friendly **SONS OF BEHEMAT PRIEST** to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly **SONS OF BEHEMAT** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
spells.effect:
If the chanting roll was 6+, you can pick another eligible unit to be a second target. Until the start of your next turn:

•  Ignore the effects of the ‘Battle Damaged’ ability on each target.
•  Each target has **WARD (6+)**.

spells.name: The Terrible Toes
spells.declare: Pick a friendly **SONS OF BEHEMAT PRIEST** to chant this prayer, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
spells.effect: Roll a dice for each model in the target unit. If the chanting roll was 8+, add 1 to the roll. For each 6+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target. Then, if any enemy models are slain by this ability, halve the target’s Move characteristic until the start of your next turn.

spells.name: Vocal Tectonics
spells.declare: Pick a friendly **SONS OF BEHEMAT PRIEST** to chant this prayer, pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
spells.effect: If the chanting roll was 10+, you can pick another eligible unit to be a second target. Until the start of your next turn, each target has **STRIKE-LAST**.

spells.name: Might of the Earth
spells.declare: Pick a friendly **SONS OF BEHEMAT PRIEST** to chant this prayer, pick each friendly **SONS OF BEHEMAT** unit on the battlefield to be the targets, then make a chanting roll of D6.
spells.effect: **Heal (D3)** each target. If the chanting roll was 8+, **Heal (3)** each target instead.

spells.name: World Titan's Stride
spells.declare: Pick a friendly **SONS OF BEHEMAT PRIEST** to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly **SONS OF BEHEMAT MONSTER** unit wholly within 18" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
spells.effect: For the rest of the turn, add 3" to the target's Move characteristic and models in the target unit can pass across enemy models and terrain features as if it had **FLY**. In addition, if the chanting roll was 6+, for the rest of the turn, each time the target uses the 'Normal Move' or 'Run' ability, after that ability has been resolved, inflict D3 mortal damage on each enemy unit the target passed across as part of that move.

spells.name: Behemat's Vengeance
spells.declare: Pick a friendly **SONS OF BEHEMAT PRIEST** to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly **SONS OF BEHEMAT MONSTER** unit wholly within 18" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
spells.effect: If the chanting roll was 8+, you can pick another eligible unit to be a second target. Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of each target's melee weapons for the rest of the turn.

artefacts.name: Glowy Lantern
artefacts.effect: If this unit is a **WIZARD** or **PRIEST**, add 1 to its power level for the rest of the battle. Otherwise, pick either the **WIZARD (1)** or **PRIEST (1)** keyword. This unit has that keyword for the rest of the battle.

artefacts.name: Krakenskin Sandals
artefacts.effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic, Rend characteristic and Damage characteristic of this unit's **Almighty Stomp**.

artefacts.name: Enchanted Portcullis
artefacts.effect: Ignore modifiers to save rolls for shooting attacks that target this unit (positive and negative).

artefacts.name: Massive Stuffin' Sack
artefacts.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
artefacts.effect: Roll 3 dice. For each roll that is at least double the target's Health characteristic, 1 model in the target unit is automatically slain.

artefacts.name: Mantle of the Wood-Kings
artefacts.effect: If this unit charged in the same turn, while it is in combat with 2 or more enemy units, add 1 to hit rolls for its combat attacks for the rest of the turn.

artefacts.name: Protecty Bits
artefacts.effect: Ignore the first damage point that would be allocated to this unit in each phase.

heroicTraits.name: Brute of Brutes
heroicTraits.effect: Ignore negative modifiers to hit rolls and wound rolls for this unit's combat attacks.

heroicTraits.name: Spell-Chomper
heroicTraits.effect: This unit can use **UNBIND** and **BANISH** abilities as if it had **WIZARD (1)**. In addition, each time an enemy **MANIFESTATION** within this unit's combat range is banished, **Heal (D3)** this unit.

heroicTraits.name: Always First In
heroicTraits.effect: This unit can move 2D6". It must end that move more than 9" from all enemy units.

heroicTraits.name: Unreasonable Tyrant
heroicTraits.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
heroicTraits.declare: Pick another visible friendly **SONS OF BEHEMAT MONSTER** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
heroicTraits.effect: Add 1 to charge rolls for the target for the rest of the turn.

heroicTraits.name: Thundering Titan
heroicTraits.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
heroicTraits.declare: If this unit charged this turn, pick a non-**HERO** enemy unit in combat with it to be the target.
heroicTraits.effect: Make a rampage roll of D6. If the roll equals or exceeds the target's Control characteristic, this unit cannot be picked to be the target of pile-in moves made by the target while there are other friendly **SONS OF BEHEMAT** units in combat with the target.

heroicTraits.name: One-Hit Wonder
heroicTraits.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle (Army), Any Combat Phase
heroicTraits.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
heroicTraits.effect: This unit can make a pile-in move. Then, roll a dice. Add 1 to the roll for cach battle round in which this unit was on the battlefield in both combat phases and did not use any **FIGHT** abilities. On a 6+, inflict 4D6 mortal damage on the target.

heroicTraits.name: Terrifying Hulk
heroicTraits.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn, Reaction: Your opponent declared a CHARGE ability for a visible non-MONSTER enemy unit within 12" of this unit
heroicTraits.effect: If this unit is not in combat, roll a dice. On a 3+, you can change one of the dice in that charge roll to a 1.

heroicTraits.name: Mega-Grump
heroicTraits.effect: This unit has **WARD (5+)** while it has 25 or more damage points.

heroicTraits.name: Grabby
heroicTraits.effect: Add 1 to hit rolls for this unit’s combat attacks that target an enemy unit contesting an objective you do not control.

other.name: Hammer Throw
other.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase
other.declare: If this unit is not in combat, pick a friendly **Mancrusher Gargant** within its combat range to be the target.
other.effect:
Roll 3D6. On a 4+, remove the target from the battlefield and set it up again wholly within a number of inches of this unit equal to the roll and visible to this unit. It can be set up in combat. The target cannot use **CHARGE** abilities for the rest of the turn.

If the target is set up in combat:
• Inflict D3 mortal damage on the target.
• Inflict 1 mortal damage on each enemy unit in combat with the target.
• The target has charged this turn.

other.name: Earthshaking Roar
other.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
other.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
other.effect: Make a rampage roll of D6. On a 3+, the target cannot use commands for the rest of the turn.

other.name: Battered Shrimp
other.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
other.declare: Pick an enemy non-**MONSTER HERO** in combat with this unit to be the target
other.effect: Both players roll off. If you win the roll-off, roll off again. Keep rolling off in this way until you lose the roll-off. Then, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the number of roll-offs made as part of this ability that you won this turn.

other.name: Windmill Walloping
other.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
other.declare: Pick an enemy **MONSTER** or **WAR MACHINE** in combat with this unit to be the target.
other.effect: Roll a number of dice equal to the target's Health characteristic. Add 1 to each roll for each consecutive turn in which the target was picked to be the target of this ability. For each 6+, allocate 1 mortal damage to the target (ward rolls cannot be made for those damage points).

other.name: Colossal Slam
other.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
other.declare: Pick an enemy **MONSTER** or **WAR MACHINE** that has no more than 1 model and is in combat with this unit to be the target.
other.effect:
If 2 or more friendly **BIG** or **LITTLE** units are in combat with the target, apply the effect below. Otherwise, make a rampage roll of D6. Subtract 1 from the roll if the target has a higher Health characteristic than this unit. On a 3+, apply the effect below.

Remove the target from the battlefield and set it up again in combat with this unit. Then, inflict D3 mortal damage on the target.

other.name: Rancid Flatulence
other.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle (Army), End of Any Turn
other.effect: For the rest of the turn, enemy units have a maximum control score of 1 while they are in combat with this unit.

other.name: That Boy's not Right
other.phaseDetails: Your Hero Phase
other.effect: Roll a dice. On a 5+, this unit can use a Prayer ability from the prayer lore you picked during army composition as if it had **PRIEST (1)**. Instead of making a chanting roll for that prayer, the chanting roll is 5 and cannot be modified.

other.name: Up For It
other.phaseDetails: Passive
other.effect: This unit’s melee weapons have **Charge (+1 Damage)**.

other.name: Always on Guard
other.phaseDetails: Passive
other.effect: This unit has **WARD (5+)** while it is wholly within 12" of and visible to a friendly **BIG** unit.

other.name: Titanic Stride
other.phaseDetails: Passive
other.effect: The unit in this Regiment of Renown can use **CHARGE** abilities even if it used a **RETREAT** ability in the same turn. In addition, no mortal damage is inflicted on the unit in this Regiment of Renown by **RETREAT** abilities.

other.name: Earth-Shaking Stomp
other.phaseDetails: Passive
other.effect: Subtract 1 from hit rolls for combat attacks made by enemy **INFANTRY** and **CAVALRY** units while they are in combat with the unit in this Regiment of Renown.

other.name: Devastating Collapse
other.phaseDetails: Passive
other.effect: When the unit in this Regiment of Renown is destroyed, before removing it from play, you and your opponent must roll off. If you roll higher, inflict 3 mortal damage on each unit (friendly and enemy) within its combat range.

other.name: Jump Up and Down
other.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
other.declare: If the unit in this Regiment of Renown charged this turn, pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target.
other.effect: Roll a dice for each model in the target unit. Add 1 to each roll if the target is contesting an objective you do not control. For each 6+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target. Then, if any of the rolls were an unmodified 1, resolve the effect of the Devastating Collapse' ability as if the unit in this Regiment of Renown had been destroyed (it is neither destroyed nor removed from play).

other.name: Dead Cunning, For a Gargant
other.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle (Army), Any Combat Phase
other.effect:
For the rest of the turn, the unit in this Regiment of Renown has **STRIKE-LAST** and **WARD (5+)**. Pick 1 of the following effects to apply for the rest of the turn:

***A Kunnin' Ruse***: Other than the **Companion** ability, weapon abilities for attacks that target the unit in this Regiment of Renown have no effect.

***A Nasty Surprise***: Add 1 to hit rolls for the unit in this Regiment of Renown's combat attacks and ignore negative modifiers to hit rolls and wound rolls for its combat attacks.

***Tricked Ya!***: Enemy units have a maximum control score of 1 while they are in combat with the unit in this Regiment of Renown.

other.name: Mighty Walloper
other.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
other.declare: Pick an enemy **MONSTER** in combat with the unit in this Regiment of Renown to be the target.
other.effect: For the rest of the turn, the unit in this Regiment of Renown's **Menhir Club** has **Crit (2 Hits)** but all attacks made with that weapon this turn must target that enemy **MONSTER**.

other.name: Protective Wards
other.phaseDetails: Passive
other.effect: The unit in this Regiment of Renown has **WARD (6+)**.

other.name: Grievous Halitosis
other.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
other.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with the unit in this Regiment of Renown to be the target.
other.effect: Roll a dice for each model in the target unit. For each 6, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target. If any enemy models are slain by this ability, the target has a maximum control score of 1 for the rest of the turn.

other.name: Fortress Wrekka
other.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle (Army), Reaction: You delcared the 'Rip It Up and Chuck It' ability for the unit in this Regiment of Renown
other.effect: After picking the target for that ability, roll a number of dice equal to the current battle round number. For each 4+, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the unit in this Regiment of Renown's **Hurled Boulder** for the rest of the turn.

battleTraits.name: Take A Run At It
battleTraits.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
battleTraits.declare: Pick any number of friendly **BIG** or **LITTLE** units to be the targets.
battleTraits.effect:
Roll a dice. If the roll is lower than the number of targets picked, this ability has no effect. Otherwise, pick an effect for each target. The effects must be different unless specified otherwise.

• Pick an enemy unit in combat with the target and roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that enemy unit equal to the roll. You can pick this effect for multiple targets.
• The target is **building momentum** for the rest of the turn.
• If the target is within 3" of a battlefield edge, remove it from the battlefield and set it up in reserve **beyond the horizon**.
• For the rest of the phase, the target can pass through enemy models and terrain features when using **MOVE** abilities as if it had **FLY**.

battleTraits.name: Argy Bargy
battleTraits.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Charge Phase
battleTraits.declare: Pick any number of friendly **BIG** or **LITTLE** units to be the targets.
battleTraits.effect:
Roll a dice. If the roll is lower than the number of targets picked, this ability has no effect. Otherwise, pick an effect for each target. The effects must be different unless specified otherwise.

• Pick an enemy unit in combat with the target and roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that enemy unit equal to the roll. You can pick this effect for multiple targets.
• If the target is **building momentum**, it is no longer **building momentum** and is **getting ready** for the rest of the turn instead.
• For the rest of the turn, each time the target makes a pile-in move, add 3" to the distance it can move.

battleTraits.name: Wrathful Rampage
battleTraits.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
battleTraits.declare: Pick any number of friendly **SONS OF BEHEMAT** units to be the targets.
battleTraits.effect:
Roll a dice. If the roll is lower than the number of targets picked, this ability has no effect. Otherwise, pick an effect for each target. The effects must be different unless specified otherwise.

• Pick an enemy unit in combat with the target and roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that enemy unit equal to the roll. You can pick this effect for multiple targets.
• If the target is **LITTLE** and is **getting ready**, it is no longer **getting ready** and has **STRIKE-FIRST** for the rest of the turn instead.
• If the target is **BIG** and is **getting ready**, it is no longer **getting ready**. Instead, either it has **STRIKE-FIRST** for the rest of the turn or it is **prepping the big one** for the rest of the turn.

battleTraits.name: Haring Back
battleTraits.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Your Turn
battleTraits.declare: If a friendly unit is in reserve **beyond the horizon**, you must pick that unit to use this ability.
battleTraits.effect: Set up that unit within 1" of a battlefield edge and more than 9" from all enemy units. If it is not possible to set it up, it wanders off and is automatically destroyed.

battleTraits.name: The Big One
battleTraits.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Your Turn
battleTraits.declare: Pick any number of friendly **BIG** or **LITTLE** units to be the targets.
battleTraits.effect:
Roll a dice. If the roll is lower than the number of targets picked, this ability has no effect. Otherwise, pick an effect for each target. The effects must be different unless specified otherwise.

• Pick an enemy unit in combat with the target and roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that enemy unit equal to the roll. You can pick this effect for multiple targets.
• If the target is **prepping the big one**, pick an enemy unit in combat with it and roll any number of dice. If any of the rolls are a 1, the target is no longer **prepping the big one**. Otherwise, add the results together, then inflict an amount of mortal damage on that enemy unit equal to the total.
